generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Represent permissions, approvals, security rules, compliance constraints, retention requirements, and policies governing data and actions.

contract.purpose_user_function: Represent permissions, approvals, security rules, retention, and action/data policies as queryable relationships.
contract.valid_inputs: Policy/rule ID, subject/resource/action, conditions, approval/retention/security metadata, source/version, and query.
contract.expected_outputs: Policy decision and policy records/relationships with reasons and provenance.
contract.state_side_effects: Would persist policy graph/version records; current gates mostly read configuration and task contracts.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Invalid/ambiguous rule, conflict, missing approval, prohibited action, or expired policy must deny or block.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Not found in current codebase as a dedicated Policy Graph. Policy data exists across configs/schemas and gates.
contract.success_evidence: No current direct graph proof. Future evidence requires persisted policy nodes/edges, deterministic decisions, versioning, and conflict tests.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: allow/deny; conditional approval; conflict; expiry; retention; version; provenance.
contract.readme_product_docs: docs/AI_NATIVE_OS_ARCHITECTURE.md §Seamless long-term memory and semantic indexing; docs/MEMORY_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md; docs/solar-architecture-code-map.md §8
